newsitem.title: USA: REEARCH ALERT-General Scanning '97 EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: REEARCH ALERT-General Scanning '97 EPS cut.

text.p: --Madison Securities said Tuesday it trimmed its 1997 arnings per share estimate on General Scanning Inc to $1.12 from $1.18. Madison noted a slower pace of growth in the semiconductor and electronics markets. It reiterated a 1996 fourth quarter estimate of $0.17.

--For full-year 1996, Madison Securities continues to estimate earnings per share of $0.66, excluding a charge for View Engineering acquisition expenses. In 1995, General Scanning earned $0.44 per share.
